274729632.description: A natural Desert Rose Selenite mineral specimen featuring distinctive rosette crystal formations. Approximate size of 10 cm as shown in the image with the measuring tape for scale.

275042814.description: This lot includes five polished blue agate geode halves and sections. Each piece reveals the natural banded patterns in shades of blue and grey, with some featuring druzy quartz crystal centers. The front faces are polished smooth to highlight the internal banding and crystal formations, while the backs and sides remain in their natural rough state. The geode pieces have natural rough edges and minor surface irregularities. These specimens display the unique characteristics of blue agate and druzy quartz.

Tubes show signs of wear and oxidation, with handwritten notes on bases indicating previous use and condition, such as 'R. Final 2C39 5-20-85 USED' and '+V.G.++'. All tubes appear structurally intact but are sold as used and may require testing or refurbishment before operational use. Suitable for collectors, restorers, or those needing period-correct replacements for vintage RF or transmitter gear. not tested
